title: Brain Board
description: A live class quiz board: pick a tile from a category, and its question opens on every device at once. Bigger tiles are harder and worth more, and a hidden Lucky Star doubles the points. Played alone, it is a practice board of sums.
notes: Oomba Live built-in mode 'board', 2D on the Oomba Kit 1.1.1 with the live pack. The server owns the board (shared state bb: categories, tile values and states, the open tile, whose pick it is; server/services/classlive-board.js) and the scoring (tile value plus up to 20% for speed, doubled on a Lucky Star, never minus points). The game draws it: the projector picks tiles (L.send('pick', {c, r})) and toggles players picking (L.send('turns', {on})); with turns on, the fastest right answer picks next from their phone (L.send('pick', ..., {toHost: true}); word 'pick'). Uses Oomba.live ready({lobby, quiz, hostView, teams, words}), the state / question / answers / reveal / result / end events (no leaderboard: the projector's end card shows the class's right answers, each phone its own, teams their podium), quiz.answer and flat() (lobby). Played alone: a 5x5 practice board of sums. Test hooks: window.__brbTest.state(), pick(c, r), answer(i), turns(). Looks like the classroom dashboard's widgets, as Crossword (Nov 2026): a dotted mint board, the board as a crisp grid of cream cards (each column's group color on its header and its tiles' top edge), the status and the question in the dark Now bar, the question card, the team score column and the end card as widget cards with an icon chip, the lobby as small cards for everyone who joined (their character, name and team color), light and dark from BRB.theme (else the device), Bricolage Grotesque. The kit and its live pack stay for the plumbing (the connection, the protocol, quiz.answer, character portraits through flat()); nothing on the wire changed. Smoke tests: tests/unit/live-board-battle-look.test.js.
